EXECUTE COMPLETE — phase 1 finished and independently verified across all 30 issues.

RESULT: 29,931 duplicate bot-authored comments deleted (all HTTP 204; 0 failures, 0 404s). 27 issues had deletions; REB-3271 and REB-3251 were 1-comment no-ops; REB-2605 had no phase-1 candidates. REB-1861 was run LAST, as planned: 5000 -> 79.

Final state, all 30 issues, from a fresh read-only sweep (fetched == Jira reported total on every one, so no truncated fetch): every issue reports DELETE=0, i.e. exactly one copy of each distinct normalized body remains. All are far below the 5000 cap, so comment sync can land again.

REB-1861 5000->79 | REB-1580 2943->45 | REB-1829 2521->37 | REB-2823 2107->37 | REB-1563 1829->35 | REB-2213 1685->29 | REB-2113 1680->18 | REB-2192 1540->22 | REB-2882 1536->24 | REB-1574 1402->22 | REB-1578 1401->21 | REB-1570 1137->33 | REB-2040 1125->21 | REB-1931 988->298 | REB-1567 974->430 | REB-3067 771->31 | REB-155 546->81 | REB-2733 453->21 | REB-424 361->28 | REB-425 346->28 | REB-327 303->27 | REB-2480 297->21 | REB-289 171->33 | REB-2605 145->145 | REB-131 118->21 | REB-427 110->28 | REB-190 109->23 | REB-341 83->32 | REB-3251 1->1 | REB-3271 1->1

INDEPENDENT VERIFICATION (not the script's own in-run check): for every one of the 27 issues with a backup, the live surviving comment set was diffed against the pre-deletion BACKUP file. Distinct normalized bodies before == after on every issue; MISSING = 0 everywhere; unmarked (non-candidate) comment counts unchanged everywhere (REB-1567 418/418, REB-1931 278/278). No distinct source comment was lost and no non-candidate comment was touched.

ARTIFACTS (~/jira-cleanup-20260820/): backup/<KEY>.json — 150MB of full pre-deletion payloads (id, ADF body, author accountId + displayName, created), written and completeness-checked BEFORE any deletion on each issue; logs/deletions.jsonl — 29,931 lines, one per deletion (key, comment id, normalized-body hash, outcome, timestamp); logs/dryrun-all.txt, logs/final-verify.txt, logs/exec-*.txt; cleanup.py — the script.

The reconcile-bridge workflow remains PAUSED (disabled_manually). It was NOT re-enabled.
